title: 2 Condos-8 Minutes to Broadway-5 King Beds
description:
Welcome to the Foxtrot Nashville - a modern, luxury 6-unit boutique hotel designed for the ultimate Nashville experience!

Enjoy the entire floor to yourselves! This listing includes 2 separate units on the 3rd floor, separated by a short interior hallway. You’ll be the only guests on the floor—perfect for groups who want space and privacy.

Includes 2 full kitchens, 2 private balconies, and a total of 5 king beds plus 2 sleeper sofas combined. Walkable to Publix, local restaurants/coffee shops.

The space
** Planning an event? Host it here at Foxtrot! Reach out about our event space on site! **

KEY FEATURES:
⭐Prime Location: < 10 Min to Broadway, The Gulch, and 12 South
⭐2 Condos on the Same Floor – 2BR & 3BR Units
⭐Combined 5-bedroom unit on one floor—perfect for large groups.
⭐5 King beds + 2 Full sleeper sofa to comfortably sleep up to 14
⭐Elevator for easy access
⭐Private Balcony
⭐5 full baths stocked with all the essentials (shampoo, conditioner, body wash, etc)
⭐Fast WiFi
⭐Well-equipped kitchen to make most meals
⭐Coffee provided
⭐Laundry room with Washer & Dryer
⭐Parking: Free Parking on premises! 

Expect a Five Star stay with us! We are always available to assist with dining and activity recommendations and help with anything else needed during your stay.

*LOCATION*

WALK to these spots in the neighborhood all within 0.2 miles / a 5 minute walk!

- Hattie B's Hot Chicken
- Publix Grocery
- 8th & Roast Coffee
- Zanies Comedy Club 
- Smiling Elephant Thai
- First Watch (Brunch)

DRIVING:
12 South --> 3 minutes
Geodis Park → 6 minutes
The Gulch --> 6 minutes
Music City Convention Center → 8 minutes
Broadway / Bridgestone Arena --> 8 minutes
Nissan Stadium --> 10 minutes
Vanderbilt University → 8 minutes
Belmont University --> 5 minutes
BNA Airport --> 15 minutes

*SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS* 
Unit 1: 
4 beds; 4 bedrooms 
Bedroom 1: 1 king bed
Bedroom 2: 1 king bed
Bedroom 3: 1 king bed
Bedroom 4: 1 full pull out sleeper sofa

Unit 2: 
3 beds; 3 bedrooms 
Bedroom 1: 1 king bed
Bedroom 2: 1 king bed
Bedroom 3: 1 full pull out sleeper sofa

*HOME LAYOUT*
Unit 1:
Living Area – Cozy and inviting open space with comfortable seating, a Smart TV, and plenty of natural light—perfect for relaxing or unwinding after a day in the city.

Kitchen & Dining Area – Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances, ample counter space, and everything you need to cook most meals

Patio – Private outdoor balcony perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening drinks

Bedroom 1 – Features a king bed plus a spacious full en suite bathroom, closet, and dresser for convenient storage

Bedroom 2 – King bed plus an attached ensuite full bathroom

Bedroom 3 - King bed plus an attached ensuite full bathroom

Bedroom 4 - Additional living/sleeping area equipped with a full sleeper sofa and enclosed with a sliding barn door for privacy

Laundry Area – Includes a washer, dryer, and ironing board for your convenience.

Unit 2:
Living Area – Cozy and inviting open space with comfortable seating, a Smart TV, and plenty of natural light—perfect for relaxing or unwinding after a day in the city.

Kitchen & Dining Area – Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances, ample counter space, and everything you need to cook most meals

Patio – Private outdoor balcony perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening drinks

Bedroom 1 – Features a king bed plus a spacious full en suite bathroom, closet, and dresser for convenient storage

Bedroom 2 – King bed plus an attached ensuite full bathroom

Bedroom 3 - Additional living/sleeping area equipped with a full sleeper sofa and enclosed with a sliding barn door for privacy

Laundry Area – Includes a washer, dryer, and ironing board for your convenience.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home during their stay.

*PARKING*
- One spot per unit (total of two) available onsite. There is additional free street parking nearby, but it is limited. There are also a couple paid lots available.

It's recommended to limit vehicles to one per unit.

There’s a Smart TV in the home—feel free to log in to your favorite streaming platform to watch shows or stream music.

Other things to note
Minimum age to book is 25. Host reserves the right to request ID verification.

Please be mindful of guests in the other units during your stay. We ask that you respect other guests by keeping your noise level to a reasonable level and adhere to the quiet hours of 10pm-8am

NO SMOKING of any kind inside the home or on the balcony.

**The home is equipped with 24/7 motion-activated security cameras that capture audio and video, exclusively monitoring the hallways and the exterior of the building to ensure your safety while respecting your privacy indoors**
